map.⚖️ 零件质量/重心估算: ⚖️ Part Mass / Center of Gravity Estimation
map.单零件质量计算，多零件组合重心估算: Single-part mass calculation and multi-part combined center-of-gravity estimation
map.📖 查看「零件质量/重心估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Part Mass / Center of Gravity Estimation Guide"
map.💡 密度单位 g/cm³，尺寸单位 mm，自动换算。重心坐标以零件几何中心为原点: 💡 Density in g/cm³, dimensions in mm, converted automatically. Center-of-gravity coordinates use the part's geometric center as the origin.
map.多零件组合重心 Xc=Σmi·xi/Σmi。: Combined center of gravity of multiple parts Xc=Σmi·xi/Σmi.
map.不规则截面形心（数值积分/分解法）。: Centroid of an irregular section (numerical integration / decomposition method).
map.校验重心相对支承的位置（防倾覆）。: Verify the position of the center of gravity relative to the supports (anti-overturning).
map.件1 质量 10 kg、xc=20 mm；件2 质量 5 kg、xc=80 mm: Part 1 mass 10 kg, xc=20 mm; part 2 mass 5 kg, xc=80 mm: Xc=(10×20+5×80)/(10+5)=(200+400)/15=40 mm. The center of gravity is closer to the heavier part.
map.Zc=Σmi·zi/Σmi，逐轴独立计算；若 Zc 超出支承包络则倾覆风险。: Zc=Σmi·zi/Σmi, computed independently per axis; if Zc lies outside the support envelope there is an overturning risk.
map.重心和形心一样吗？: Is the center of gravity the same as the centroid?
map.均质时重心=形心（几何中心）；非均质需用质量加权，不能简单用几何。: For a homogeneous body the center of gravity equals the centroid (geometric center); for a non-homogeneous body, mass weighting is required and geometry alone will not do.
map.为什么算重心？: Why compute the center of gravity?
map.旋转件需动平衡、运输件需防倾覆、吊装件需定吊点，重心是这些设计的基础。: Rotating parts need dynamic balancing, transported parts need anti-overturning measures and lifted parts need defined lifting points; the center of gravity is the basis of these designs.
